title: Signal Atlas: per-route deployment exposure analytics and rollback heuristics
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a new Console feature set (Signal Atlas) that surfaces per-route and per-cohort signal comparisons for canary/A-B/shadow deployments, supports diffed metric visualizations, integrates traces and sampled payloads, and exposes configurable auto-rollback heuristics tied to route-level SLOs.
updates: 2026-02-26 — Drafted PRD with scope: per-route metric panel, cohort diff view, trace-linking, and rollback policy editor. Decided to prioritize latency/error rate and model output drift signals for MVP.

2026-03-02 — Eng sync: runtime team (ENG-4219) confirmed an events export for per-request metadata (model_id, route, cohort_id, latency_ms, token_count) will be available in 2 sprints. That unlocks per-route aggregates without heavy query load on metrics DB.

2026-03-05 — Design review: Figma mockups reviewed (link below). Feedback: make cohort legend color-blind-friendly, add toggles for normalized vs absolute diffs, and include a small-sample warning when cohort size < 1k.

2026-03-08 — Risk discussion: potential privacy exposure from sampled payloads. Decided to redact user PII by default and only show truncated prompts/outputs in secure mode. Flagged for security review if we enable full-payload sampling for on-prem customers.

2026-03-10 — Product-Eng trade-off: two approaches for auto-rollback heuristics: (A) threshold-based rules evaluated in Console (fast to implement); (B) ML-driven anomaly detector evaluated in runtime (more accurate but longer build). MVP will deliver (A) with extensibility hooks for (B).

2026-03-12 — QA plan: create synthetic canary datasets to validate diff computations, add e2e testing for cohort filtering, and write fuzz tests for rollback policy evaluation. QA owner: Lina Park (ENG QA).
Planned next steps: land backend event export (ENG milestone), implement frontend cohort-diff visualization, add trace linking and rollback editor, run internal dogfood with Redwood Console demo org.
